items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: I didn't know Orson Welles as a person.

ctx.x: Orson Welles came around Central Avenue, did he not?
I didn't know Orson Welles as a person. So far as his coming and going, I couldn't honestly say.
I know he's a jazz fan, but I had heard that he (inaudible). used to come to the Alabam
